rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects to the AgentFolio platform for AI agent identity and reputation management. Look up agent profiles, search by skill or keyword, verify trust scores with on-chain SATP and off-chain OATR data, compare agents side-by-side, browse marketplace jobs, and export portable identity credentials. Covers the full AgentFolio API including leaderboard rankings, endorsement history, and score tracking over time.
